notes: §1985:VII.2.12.4 GR2: "There are seven forms of the RERUN clause" and "The implementor must provide at least one of the specified forms of the RERUN clause." WiseOwl COBOL provides form d: "When the integer-1 RECORDS phrase is used. In this case, the rerun information is written on the device specified by implementor-name-1, which must be specified in the ON phrase, whenever integer-1 records of file-name-2 have been processed. File-name-2 may be either an input or output file with any organization or access." FileConnector.RecordProcessed is the one count, asked at the terminal of every READ (ReadSucceeded), WRITE, REWRITE and DELETE of the sequential, relative and indexed connectors; a statement that did not complete is not a record processed, the count belongs to the OPEN, a device the host refuses is the file's I-O status 30, and an integer-1 of zero marks no rerun point. The other six forms (END OF REEL or UNIT, CLOCK-UNITS, condition-name-1) are accepted with their syntax rules asked (COBOL6496, COBOL6529-COBOL6531, COBOL1639) and write nothing; the determination is docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3.11. Before PB5198 no form wrote anything: the generated program was the same with and without the clause.

next.reason: 1985: "There are seven forms of the RERUN clause, based on the several conditions under which rerun points can be established."; 2023: "No 2023 clause carries the RERUN clause; no candidate covers rerun points or any RERUN form.". No 2023 clause holds the RERUN feature and no candidate covers rerun points, so 2023 lacks the RERUN clause.
